newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble firms ahead T-bill sales, on tax payments.
newsitem.headline: Rouble firms ahead T-bill sales, on tax payments.

text.p: The rouble firmed on Monday ahead of higher-than-usual sales of government securities and on demand from major bank clients seeking funds to pay taxes, dealers said.
roubles/dollar Jun 16 midday Jun 16 early Jun 13 close

"Dollar selling started in the morning as overnight credit rates were high. The Central Bank later stabilised the market when it came out to buy (dollars)," Aljba Alliance Bank chief dealer Dmitry Slobodnik said.
The Central Bank has been buying dollars steadily for several weeks as the rouble nudges the upper limit of the Central Bank's buy/sell rates.
Dealers said the rouble was also firming ahead of Wednesday's record large sale of 20 trillion roubles of GKO discount Treasury bills and OFZ interest-bearing bonds.
Payments of tax arrears of such major companies as Gazprom was another source of support for the rouble, they added.
